rows.grounds: prior participial compound referring to earlier prescription
indicates doubling of the prescribed measure
denotes action done by desire or will
emphatic negation reinforcing the prescribed measure

items.question: What degree of expiation is required when a ritual fault is committed intentionally?
premises: A ritual fault may be committed intentionally.
Earlier verses prescribe a standard measure of expiation.
Intentional commission alters the required measure of expiation.
items.inference: Therefore, an intentional ritual fault requires performing twice the previously prescribed expiation.
items.plain_english: If the fault is committed intentionally, one must perform an expiation that is twice what was previously prescribed, and not otherwise.
